cross_verification.note_en: Mozambique's official passport-issuing authority is SENAMI (Serviço Nacional de Migração, senami.gov.mz), which publishes a PDF titled 'Passaporte Biométrico - Requisitos'. Every direct-fetch attempt against senami.gov.mz and its PDF (via WebFetch and via curl) failed with a connection error (ECONNREFUSED) during this research pass, so its contents could not be independently confirmed, even though web search indexing suggests it states a white background, both ears visible, and to avoid white-colored clothing. The Embassy of Mozambique in Washington, D.C. (usa.embamoc.gov.mz) was reachable and its Passport pages (/index.php/passport/ and /?page_id=87) were fetched directly, but they contain only a link to a downloadable request form and drop-off/pick-up office hours — no photo specification. Because the SENAMI PDF could not be independently verified by direct fetch, per the truthfulness gate nothing was carried into verified for mz-passport specifically (contrast mz-visa.json, where the embassy's Visa page was directly confirmed).
